subject: Private footprint consolidation and analytics enclave at renewal

Subject: Private footprint consolidation & new analytics enclave at renewal

Hi Logan —

Quick note as we start our renewal discussions: DataMosaic is planning to consolidate two existing private VPCs (analytics-prod and analytics-staging) into a single Private deployment with an additional isolated analytics enclave dedicated to research workloads. Goal is to:
- Keep production cluster (analytics-prod) unchanged for 6 months,
- Provision a new isolated analytics enclave (separate tenancy + stricter network ACLs) to run heavier retraining/eval workloads,
- Align the term of the new enclave to our main contract renewal on 2027-02-01, and
- Add an initial 20% capacity buffer for the first 90 days.

High level asks: can Redwood provision an isolated enclave (on our Private instance) within an 8–10 week lead time? What does a term amendment and pricing path look like for adding an enclave + reserved capacity? We also have a handful of compliance questions (audit window, KMS integration) — happy to route those to your security contact.

I’ve included Ben from procurement and Tomas from platform ops on the thread. Can we get a short call early next week to align scope and timelines?

Thanks,
Nina
Nina Patel
Director, Platform Engineering
DataMosaic

Thanks for the context. A few technical clarifying questions that will materially change sizing and lead time:

1) Workload profile for the enclave — primarily long-running batched retraining jobs, or low-latency online evals? Approx. concurrency and average request size (tokens) matters.
2) Expected QPS at peak and expected sustained throughput (tokens/minute).
3) Do you expect to run larger model variants in the enclave (e.g., 7B vs 70B), or will you use the same model family currently in prod?
4) KV/prefix cache expectations and whether you want shared KV across enclaves or fully isolated caches.

If you can fill the attached capacity-sizing-form.pdf and return, I’ll produce a recommended cluster topology (number of nodes, GPU types, and a suggested quantization profile) and flag anything that would extend the 8–10 week schedule.

If you prefer a quick call instead of the form, I can be available during the proposed Tuesday slot.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Private footprint consolidation & new analytics enclave at renewal — next steps

Ben/Nina — thanks for the redlines and the details, and thanks Karthik for the sizing checklist. Summary / agreed next steps: 

1) Karthik will get a cluster topology recommendation within 2 business days once DataMosaic returns the capacity-sizing-form.pdf (we flagged shared vs isolated KV as the biggest schedule driver).
2) I’ll route the datamosaic_msa_redlines.pdf to our legal/finance and aim for a contract amendment draft within 5 business days; if their edits are narrow we can have a signature-ready amendment in ~10 business days.
3) Provisioning: once the amendment is signed and we receive the PO, typical lead time for the isolated enclave with the requested 20% buffer is 8–10 weeks (canary + staged cutover recommended).
4) Security/Compliance: Neha will pick up KMS/audit window questions — Neha, can you confirm KMS options (customer-managed key vs Redwood-managed) and expected audit log retention policy?
5) Schedule: hold the Tuesday Nov 3 10:00 PT slot as a working session to confirm sizing and to surface any procurement blockers (if Nov 3 is now past, we'll reschedule — proposing Nov 8 or Nov 9 as alternatives).

Resources linked: HubSpot deal DM-2026-0421, provisioning lead times, and the DocuSign link Ben shared.

Logan Wright
